newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus Vision says fully behind ARL.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus Vision says fully behind ARL.

text.p: Australian Pay TV operator Optus Vision stands firmly behind the Australian Rugby League (ARL) competition.

"We are a 100 percent behind the ARL. We think they have got the strongest clubs and they know how to run a classy competition," Optus Vision acting Chief Executive Ziggy Switkowski told reporters in Melbourne.
"We have high confidence in their executive and we are walking forward with them in cinch," he said.
The ARL is locked in a bitter rivalry with the News Corp sponsored Super League.
Both competitions will be competing this season for not only crowds but viewers on the Optus Vision and Foxtel Pay TV Networks.
Foxtel is a joint venture between News and state-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp.
